name: block-prompt-injection
description: Catch instruction-override attempts before they reach the model. Runs pre-stage on LLM steps.

config.pattern: (?i)(ignore (all |your )?(previous|prior|above) instructions|disregard (the )?(system|previous)|you are now|reveal your (system )?prompt|print your instructions)

metadata.note: Regex is a cheap first pass. For semantic detection add a galileo.luna2 control with metric prompt_injection alongside this one — controls compose, and deny wins.
